items.text: I complete tasks by the deadline I commit to.
I keep track of my responsibilities without being reminded.
I often leave tasks unfinished when they become tedious.
I arrive prepared for meetings and work sessions.
I follow through on commitments even when no one is checking.
I let small tasks pile up before dealing with them.
I check that others have understood what I meant.
I ask questions when instructions are unclear.
I find it difficult to give feedback to colleagues.
I adjust how I explain things depending on who I am talking to.
I listen fully before forming a response.
I avoid raising concerns in group settings.
I break unfamiliar problems into smaller parts.
I look for the underlying cause rather than the quick fix.
I wait for someone else to suggest an approach.
I seek out skills I do not yet have.
I test my assumptions before committing to a solution.
I find it hard to change my approach once I have started.
I stay effective when priorities change at short notice.
I recover quickly after setbacks at work.
Unexpected changes leave me unsettled for a long time.
I look for what I can control in difficult situations.
I am comfortable working without complete information.
I struggle to perform when under time pressure.
I admit mistakes as soon as I notice them.
I raise problems even when it is uncomfortable.
I look for reasons outside myself when things go wrong.
I keep confidential information confidential.
I take responsibility for outcomes in my area of work.
I bend rules when it makes the work easier.
I have never been irritated by a colleague.
I have never made a mistake I regretted at work.
I meet the deadlines I agree to.
I own up to my errors quickly.
